JSON-LD script tag is stripped from output (security) but metadata may be extracted

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<html><head><title>Article</title><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":"My Article","author":{"@type":"Person","name":"Jane Doe"},"datePublished":"2024-01-15"}</script></head><body><h1>My Article</h1><p>Article body text.</p></body></html>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
